brief: A fictitious open workshop invites adults to a Saturday session making objects from leftover materials. All four variants carry identical content and assets. This tests a relationship, not four candidate brand directions.

copy.title: Make room.
copy.description: A morning to work with your hands. Bring an idea, try a new material, and make something you did not know you could.
copy.support: Paper offcuts, clay, wire and a long shared table. A little guidance when you need it, and time to follow your own curiosity.
